subject: Can I return my order?
body: Hi, I received my order 10 days ago. The item is unused and still in the original packaging. Can I return it for a refund?

subject: Charged twice for one order
body: Hello, I think I was charged twice for the same order. One charge was yesterday and another charge showed up today. Can you help me check this?

subject: Login issue on mobile app
body: I cannot log in to the NimbusShop app. I already tried my usual password but it keeps showing an error message.

subject: Possible data loss after app crash
body: After the app crashed, my saved order details disappeared. I am worried this is data loss and I need someone to check my account.

subject: Still no answer about my package
body: This is my fourth time contacting support this week. My package still has not arrived and I need a clear update.

subject: Refund after 90 days?
body: Can I get a refund after 90 days if I used the product only once? I could not find this exact case on your website.
